content.json:
## AI integration plane
Gateway spans and metrics from the Tool, MCP, A2A, Event and Identity gateways. A call counts as successful only when `integration.result_class == ok`; an HTTP 200 carrying a business error is `business_reject`.

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where isnotempty(Properties["integration.system"])
| extend system = tostring(Properties["integration.system"]), result = tostring(Properties["integration.result_class"])
| summarize total = count(), ok = countif(result == "ok") by system
| extend success_pct = round(100.0 * ok / total, 1)
| order by success_pct asc
content.title: Success rate by system

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where isnotempty(Properties["integration.result_class"])
| summarize calls = count() by result_class = tostring(Properties["integration.result_class"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Result classes over time (ok, business_reject, timeout, authz_deny...)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where tostring(Properties["service.component"]) in ("tool-gateway", "mcp-gateway")
| summarize p95_ms = percentile(DurationMs, 95), calls = count() by tool = tostring(Properties["integration.operation"])
| order by p95_ms desc
content.title: p95 latency by tool (ms)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "queue.depth"
| extend queue = tostring(Properties["queue"])
| where queue endswith "$deadletterqueue" or queue endswith "/parked"
| summarize depth = max(Max) by queue, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Poison / parked queue depth (app gauge)

content.query:
AzureMetrics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.SERVICEBUS" and MetricName == "DeadletteredMessages"
| summarize dead_lettered = max(Maximum) by EntityName = tostring(split(ResourceId, "/")[-1]), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Service Bus dead-lettered messages (platform metric)

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where isnotempty(Properties["integration.identity_mode"])
| summarize calls = count() by identity_mode = tostring(Properties["integration.identity_mode"])
content.title: OBO vs agent identity mix

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where tostring(Properties["integration.result_class"]) == "business_reject"
| project TimeGenerated, system = tostring(Properties["integration.system"]), operation = tostring(Properties["integration.operation"]), business_key = tostring(Properties["integration.business_key"]), vendor_code = tostring(Properties["integration.vendor_code"]), actor = tostring(Properties["integration.actor"])
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Business rejects (HTTP 200 with error payload)

content.query:
AppMetrics
| where Name == "process.completions"
| summarize completions = sum(Sum) by process = tostring(Properties["process"]), outcome = tostring(Properties["outcome"])
content.title: Process completions by outcome

content.query:
AppDependencies
| where isnotempty(Properties["integration.business_key"])
| project TimeGenerated, actor = tostring(Properties["integration.actor"]), subject = tostring(Properties["integration.subject"]), mode = tostring(Properties["integration.identity_mode"]), operation = tostring(Properties["integration.operation"]), business_key = tostring(Properties["integration.business_key"]), result = tostring(Properties["integration.result_class"]), OperationId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Audit view: who did what to which business key
